candidate.title: checkValidTransition ratio-fallback branch allows collateral withdrawal/transfer that leaves a synthetic position below maintenance margin (margin bypass -> bad debt)

ice.exploit_path: Perp (CAP_MARGIN_CHECK=Risk) + open position; signed full-collateral withdrawal -> checkValidTransition inverted ratio guard + initRisk==0 gating never reverts -> collateral leaves while position open.

evidence.attacker_model: A perp account owner extracts their collateral while keeping an open leveraged synthetic position, shifting the loss of that position onto the protocol as bad debt.
evidence.preconditions: Perp (CAP_MARGIN_CHECK=Risk) + open position; signed full-collateral withdrawal -> checkValidTransition inverted ratio guard + initRisk==0 gating never reverts -> collateral leaves while position open.
evidence.who_gains: Account holder withdrawing collateral while keeping leveraged exposure
evidence.impact: A perp user can withdraw/transfer collateral out of an account that holds an open leveraged synthetic position so the position is left below maintenance margin or fully unbacked. The maintenance-margin invariant (risk <= value*FXP) is violated post-op; the resulting deficit is bad debt borne by the protocol/counterparties. Permissionless from the user's side (user signs their own withdrawal; txBatcher merely relays).
evidence.suggested_fix: Correct the value/risk ratio comparison and apply the value-non-decrease guard unconditionally; make validateWithdrawal margin-aware.
